concept.reason: Direct reference imagery and taxon-specific sources sufficient for original silhouette; no extra concept image.

scope: Original Amargasaurus cazaui living stylization based on photographed museum skeleton cast and published soft-tissue interpretation; not a specimen scan.

scientific_limits.en: Living soft tissues, exact sail margins, head completion, color, posture and dimensions are estimates. The 2022 histological study supports a cervical sail interpretation rather than confident horn sheaths; the full PMC article encountered a browser challenge and was not accessed. Paired spine-supported ridges remain visible, but exact transverse connective tissue is not claimed.
scientific_limits.zh: 活体软组织、颈帆精确边缘、头部补全、颜色、姿态及尺寸均为估值。2022年组织学研究支持颈帆解释，而非确定的角鞘；PMC全文遇浏览器验证，未访问全文。成对骨棘支撑的嵴仍保持可辨，但不主张精确横向连接组织。

dimensions_estimate_m.basis: Artistic envelope, not measurement of museum mount.

shape_requirements: Preserve original paired tall spine rows projecting along neck; front/oblique view must distinguish left and right.
Tall paired backward-inclining cervical supports transition to lower back relief over a compact sauropod body.
Use modest continuous skin-covered longitudinal membranes/ridges between adjacent cervical supports, with paired rows readable; not isolated exposed keratin spear horns.
Small head, moderately long neck and long tapering tail; sturdy quadrupedal stance.
construction_notes: Sail is an evidence-informed interpretation, not a new exact membrane-height gate. Original paired tall rows remain the defining geometry.
Do not reproduce metal supports or assume cast skull completion is entirely fossil-preserved.
Natural muted skin palette is artistic; no display or defense function asserted.

shape_gate.en: Shape criterion: paired tall spine rows projecting along the neck. Retain this anatomical combination when compared with nearby forms; a name, scale or pose change alone does not qualify.
shape_gate.zh: 形态判据：沿颈部伸出的成对高棘列。须与相近形态对照保留这一结构组合；仅改名称、尺寸或姿态不成立。

modeling_brief.en: Original low-poly brief: block paired tall spine rows projecting along the neck with a small number of readable masses; preserve negative spaces and joint transitions. Use a restrained neutral palette; simplify surface texture only after the silhouette reads. Validate the diagnostic feature before detailed geometry.
modeling_brief.zh: 原创低多边形说明：用少量清晰体块组织沿颈部伸出的成对高棘列；保留负空间与关节过渡。采用克制的中性色；轮廓成立后再简化表面纹理。精细几何制作前须核实鉴别特征。

material_profile: palette-only static original geometry; restrained natural palette; no reference images embedded
gray_model_gate: Three low-cost front/side/oblique checks before detailing; original inventory shape combination must read. No extra views except a specific unresolved problem.
final_evidence: Four exact-export front/side/top/perspective views; perspective may equal preview. Existing technical/export/viewer gates, two isolated rebuilds and fresh independent QA remain required.
